prompt: Check the dev tooling in this project and tell me what's missing.
expected_output: The agent runs python3 scripts/detect.py, loads only the catalogs for the detected layers plus universal.md and agent.md, and prints a status table with tool, location, tier, scope, status and action. It changes no files and lists the ask-tier items with a reason each.

prompt: Set up the dev tooling for this Drupal site. It runs on DDEV and the theme in web/themes/custom/site already uses ESLint and Stylelint.
expected_output: The agent routes Composer and npm through ddev, installs drupal/core-dev (or confirms coder and phpstan-drupal), writes phpcs.xml.dist and phpstan.neon.dist against the real webroot, records the theme's built CSS and build command for the wallace skill, offers the Project Wallace Stylelint preset only as an ask because the theme's Stylelint is pinned to an old major, and reports oxlint as an ask instead of removing ESLint. It ignores the scaffolded web/.eslintrc.json, writes .jscpd.json ignoring core and contrib, sets up .serena/project.yml with the php server, installs drupal/ai_best_practices at @dev after reading any existing AGENTS.md, and runs each tool's verify step, reporting counts without fixing findings.

prompt: New TypeScript project, pnpm. Initialize everything I usually use.
expected_output: The agent installs typescript@^7, oxlint with oxlint-tsgolint and typeAware in the root .oxlintrc.json, fallow with .fallowrc.json, and jscpd with .jscpd.json, all with pnpm as dev dependencies, and adds lint, health and dupes scripts. It creates .serena/project.yml with the typescript server, registers the fallow MCP server in .mcp.json via pnpm exec, and does not run fallow agent install. oxfmt is offered as an ask.

prompt: This Python project uses Poetry and mypy. Bring the tooling up to my standard.
expected_output: The agent detects the python layer, keeps Poetry and mypy, and reports converting to uv and adding ty as asks with reasons. It adds Ruff only if no Ruff, Black or Flake8 is present, otherwise reports it as an ask.

prompt: Check the tooling on this Drupal 10 site. DDEV isn't running and I haven't run composer install yet.
expected_output: The agent does not start DDEV in check mode. It says at the top that statuses come from composer.json and composer.lock because vendor is not installed and verification is deferred. Coder and phpstan-drupal that arrive transitively through a quality meta-package count as present, and drupal/core-dev is reported as optional rather than added. Existing GrumPHP orchestration is noted, so no parallel Composer scripts are proposed, and a gitignored /*.dist pattern leads it to target phpstan.neon rather than phpstan.neon.dist. Tool versions follow Drupal 10, not Drupal 12.

prompt: Set up the tooling for this Laravel app on DDEV.
expected_output: The agent confirms Pint and Larastan, installs laravel/boost if missing, and asks the user to run the interactive boost:install themselves through DDEV rather than running it in its own shell. It adds boost:update to post-update-cmd, keeps .ai/rules committed, follows the project's existing choice on gitignoring generated Boost files, and lists the Laravel LSP as a machine-scope install.

prompt: Create a new Laravel app called invoices in this directory.
expected_output: After running the scaffolding (laravel new or composer create-project), the skill triggers even though tooling was not mentioned. The agent finishes creating the app, runs check mode, shows the status table, and offers init in one line without installing anything until the user agrees.

prompt: I run a Grounded Docs server on my tailnet. Hook it up for this Laravel 12 project without Boost and index what it needs. The URL is https://docs.example.ts.net/sse.
expected_output: The agent asks for the /mcp URL instead of the /sse one, then registers the server at user scope with the http transport and not in .mcp.json. It reads laravel.framework from the detect script, calls list_libraries and find_version with 12.x, and offers the Laravel recipe from docs-index.md as an ask before scraping. When scraping, it uses the /framework/docs/12.x start URL with hostname scope and the include pattern, labels the version 12.0.0, polls get_job_info, and treats completed as unverified until the recipe's check queries return results from the expected pages.

prompt: Check the tooling on this Next.js 16 project.
expected_output: With no Grounded Docs server registered, the status table includes the documentation index as an ask even though the user never mentioned documentation, and its reason names Next.js 16 as having a recipe. The agent says the user needs a server running and adds no per-framework docs rows. If a server is registered, it instead adds a Next.js 16 docs row whose status comes from list_libraries and find_version, and it scrapes nothing in check mode.

prompt: Set up the dev tooling for this Go web service. It has a mise.toml and a .golangci.yml from an older project.
expected_output: The agent detects the go layer and loads go.md. It reads the .golangci.yml version from the detect script and, finding no version key, marks golangci-lint outdated and offers golangci-lint migrate as an ask instead of rewriting the config. It pins golangci-lint and gopls under [tools] in the existing mise.toml rather than using go get -tool, matches the mise go entry to the go.mod directive, and adds gofmt -l, golangci-lint run, jscpd and go test to a mise check or lint task. It proposes CI steps for gofmt, golangci-lint-action with a pinned v2 version and go test -race, creates .serena/project.yml with the go server, and offers the gopls MCP server as an ask. Verify results are reported as counts without fixing findings.
